name: AM 2:00 ~Neko to Tsukiyo no Buranko~
source:
3 guys, 3 totally different situations. Unknown to each they all share one similar trait. That is, a hobby to often visit a certain park during the night to feed a stray cat. What would happen if two of them found out about each others existence…?

[taken from [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/02/24/bl-game-review-am-200-neko-to-tsukiyo-no-buranko-by-amanatto/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
三个男人，三种截然不同的处境。他们彼此并不知道，自己都有同一个习惯：经常在夜里前往某座公园，给一只流浪猫喂食。如果其中两人发现了彼此的存在，会发生什么…？

[摘自[url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/02/24/bl-game-review-am-200-neko-to-tsukiyo-no-buranko-by-amanatto/]Koorin的博客[/url]]
